feat: add documentation and video processing utilities
- Add Y-shirt sewing instructions (Y-shirt_Sewing_Instructions.md). - Implement video similarity detection (similar_video.py) and image noise generation (rand-noise-image.py). - Add AI-based image upscaling script (upscale_image.py) and Nushell script for audio conversion (wav2flac.nu). - Improve `mov2mp4.py` with cross-platform file path handling, case-insensitive extension support, and updated batch configuration.
